rule: HM3D official split: train -> train; val (incl. minival, a subset of val) -> val or test by sha256(scene_id) parity (even: val, odd: test)
reason: Proposal 6-1 asks for Train/Validation/Test environments. ObjectNav work on HM3D trains on the official train split and evaluates on val (test annotations are withheld), so val is divided per building into Val and Test; a building never appears in two splits.
